instruction: Inspect source-bound outcomes for each open finding; respond, challenge, then test. Admission is not effectiveness. No new authority.

reference_contract.entry: Each new native production plan declares reference_scope and explicit reuse_existing/acquire/none_needed decisions; legacy offline/frozen records are not native authority.
reference_contract.qualification: Purpose, actual coverage observations, governs/excluded authority, provenance/rights-use and bound inspected source media; generated physical claims need non-generated corroboration.
reference_contract.propagation: Grounding.reference_readiness -> Derivation.reference_mapping -> brief -> planning challenge -> actual execution/review; copies/digests do not prove truth.
reference_contract.retro: Every current-protocol retrospective response assesses retain/supplement/replace/no_reference_issue; reference_gap outcome opens an immediate finding; reference gap returns to Grounding.
reference_contract.acquisition: Image search and built-in images agent-owned; paid video requires exact approval and persistent budget guard; raw chat tools remain instruction governed.
reference_contract.limits: Source bindings and declared coverage are structural checks. They cannot establish truthful viewing, physical correctness, artistic sufficiency or director acceptance. Reference readiness review does not replace full-speed motion/audio checks.
